verdict.rationale: Thoropass's Monitors feature automatically checks connected systems (AWS, Azure, GCP) against control requirements, gives a centralized view to investigate violations, and integrations continuously collect compliance data while alerting to violations — directly matching continuous automated control testing rather than annual-only audits. missing for 10: explicit hour-level latency/SLA claims for alerting, and independent/hands-on corroboration of monitor responsiveness.
